skillDispatch.when: Building or changing Bubble Tea models, commands, messages, or component composition.
Designing terminal layout, navigation, keyboard, mouse, color, or accessibility behavior.
Writing or reviewing TUI model and interaction tests.

rules.guidance: Drive TUI model updates synchronously and assert rendered state, messages, and transitions. Use terminal emulation only when model-level tests cannot prove the behavior, and keep layout and interaction policy in repository-owned design guidance.
